headline: 10 injured as Chhatra Dal and Shibir clash near Dhaka Alia Madrasa
summary: The violence broke out in multiple waves throughout Tuesday, leaving the Madrasa's principal among the injured.
details: At least 10 people, including the principal of Dhaka Alia Madrasa, were injured during clashes between activists of Chhatra Dal and Islami Chhatra Shibir on Tuesday.
The violence erupted around 5:15 PM in front of the Madrasa-i-Alia in the capital, involving the throwing of bricks and stones and repeated chases between the two groups.
Tensions had been building since the morning, following an earlier clash between the two student wings at Jagannath University over participation in the second anniversary of the July mass uprising.
Another round of clashes occurred around 3:00 PM, leading to injuries and causing significant traffic congestion on the road for approximately two hours.
The situation remained volatile into the evening, with reports of continued chases and skirmishes between the opposing factions.
caption:
10 people injured, including a school principal, after violent student wing clashes in Dhaka.

Tensions had been building since the morning, following an earlier clash between the two student wings at Jagannath University over participation in the second anniversary of the July mass uprising.

Another round of clashes occurred around 3:00 PM, leading to injuries and causing significant traffic congestion on the road for approximately two hours.

The situation remained volatile into the evening, with reports of continued chases and skirmishes between the opposing factions.

headline_marked: Scores injured as [[clashes hit Jagannath University]] between student wings
headline: Scores injured as clashes hit Jagannath University between student wings
summary: Violence erupted at Jagannath University as members of Chhatra Dal, Shibir, and other student groups clashed, leaving many injured.
details: Violence broke out at Jagannath University (JnU) as members of Chhatra Dal and Shibir clashed with activists from the Jagannath University Central Students' Union (JCSU) and Chhatra Shakti.
Reports indicate that around 50 people were injured during the confrontation, with both sides claiming scores of their members were hurt.
The clashes occurred in two separate rounds, leaving the university campus in a state of tension.
The incident involved physical altercations between the rival student wings, leading to multiple injuries that required medical attention.
caption:
Violence erupts at Jagannath University! Around 50 students injured in clashes between rival student wings.

Violence broke out at Jagannath University (JnU) as members of Chhatra Dal and Shibir clashed with activists from the Jagannath University Central Students' Union (JCSU) and Chhatra Shakti.

Reports indicate that around 50 people were injured during the confrontation, with both sides claiming scores of their members were hurt.

The clashes occurred in two separate rounds, leaving the university campus in a state of tension.

The incident involved physical altercations between the rival student wings, leading to multiple injuries that required medical attention.
